reuse.why: Changes only the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate (via a small isHoliday helper), which every holiday-aware path in the tree already goes through.

duplication.why: The MM-DD match is written once; no logic is repeated.

placement.why: The holiday match stays in shared/schedules.ts next to isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, where the tree keeps that rule.

scope.why: A five-line change to the predicate plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, named, single-point change that every consumer (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) picks up automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through isNonWorkingDay; no caller matches holidays on its own.
